uncertain_points.claim: The 10-bit FSM enumeration defines only two legal states (StRandReset = 10'b1001111000, StRandReady = 10'b0110000100) out of 1024 possible patterns. The module does not guarantee detection or containment if the state register is corrupted to an illegal value.
uncertain_points.cond: If a soft error flips bits in the state register
uncertain_points.risk: The FSM may enter an undefined state with no recovery mechanism, potentially leading to persistent invalid entropy outputs or security-relevant misbehavior if not caught elsewhere.
